The '''Fugitive Tracking Droid Enhancer''' was a device used by [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]], that could improve their precision and stamina.

{{Tech-stub}}
==Behind the scenes==
The Fugitive Tracking Droid Enhancer featured in the [[Star Wars video games#Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|MMORPG]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', where it is given to bounty hunters who have reached Combat Level 78
